description: Stage 2 of the 3-file pipeline (progress.json -> review.json -> plans.json). An entry lands here ONLY when its progress.json score reached 100 with zero tbi/tbd/warnings. Workflow for ANY agent picking this up, no prior context needed: (1) pick one entry with review_status='pending_review'; (2) re-run the exact command(s) named in its 'evidence' field, do not trust the text -- run it again; (3) if the re-run output matches the evidence claim exactly, set review_status='passed', set 'review_verified_on' to today, leave it here permanently; (4) if the re-run output does NOT match (test now fails, file now missing, claim no longer true), do NOT edit this file's score -- instead: delete the entry from review.json, and add/restore it to progress.json's entries[] with score reset below 100, status='open', and a new warning describing exactly what the re-run found wrong. progress.json is the single place an open issue lives; review.json never holds an open issue. Never mark review_status='passed' without actually re-running the evidence command in this same turn.

entries.purpose: bf16-quantization preconditions: RuntimeConfig.dtype validation/bfloat16 support; Model.with_hdp_initial_state dtype-respecting cast.
entries.evidence: RuntimeConfig(dtype='banana') now raises ValueError; RuntimeConfig(dtype='bfloat16').jnp_dtype == jax.numpy.bfloat16; with_hdp_initial_state casts H0/w0 via _runtime_config_from_metadata(self.cfg.metadata).jnp_dtype instead of hardcoded float32. Full suite: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q -> 2696 passed, 74 skipped, 9 xfailed, 0 failed (1166s).
entries.review_command: python3 -c "import jaxfne as jtfne; jtfne.RuntimeConfig(dtype='bfloat16')" && python3 -m pytest tests/ -q

entries.purpose: Configuration.population(N, neurons={...}) fluent verb for per-layer neuron counts (jaxfne-config canonical column builder).
tbd: Confirmed via reproduction 2026-07-01: L4's hardcoded _SUITE2_LAYER_CELL_TYPES_V1 default (E:0.25,PV:0.45,SST:0.15,VIP:0.15) combined with Python banker's rounding at N=2 gives exactly the observed ['PV','VIP'] bug -- root cause fully explained, not just worked around.
warnings: Only reproduced at N=2 with a single named canonical layer ('L4'); not yet checked at other small N or non-canonical layer names -- may be narrower or broader than stated.
entries.evidence: Fixed _area_layer_cell_type_map (jaxfne/core.py) to fall back to a broadcast of metadata['cell_types'] before the hardcoded suite2 default. Repro: Configuration().geometry(layer_thickness={'L4':1.0}).population(N=2, neurons={'L4':2}).cell_types({'E':0.5,'PV':0.5})... -> neuron_table() cell_types now ['E','PV'] (was ['PV','VIP']). Regression: python3 -m pytest tests/test_configuration_geometry_population_interarea.py tests/test_suite_no2_upgrade.py tests/test_multi_area_source_projector.py tests/test_multi_area_emitter_runtime.py -q -> 51 passed.
entries.review_command: python3 -c "import jaxfne as jtfne; cfg = jtfne.Configuration().geometry(layer_thickness={'L4':1.0}).population(N=2, neurons={'L4':2}).cell_types({'E':0.5,'PV':0.5}).emitter(kind='izhikevich').field(kind='laminar_proxy').probe(kind='lfp_proxy', n_contacts=5); assert sorted(r['cell_type'] for r in jtfne.construct(cfg).neuron_table()) == ['E','PV']" && python3 -m pytest tests/test_configuration_geometry_population_interarea.py tests/test_suite_no2_upgrade.py tests/test_multi_area_source_projector.py tests/test_multi_area_emitter_runtime.py -q
